Episode 184. Beyond Fate (10)
Jin's face contorted as he gasped for air.
Rosa's face, from where the chain fragments fell, seemed to pass slowly, as if frozen in time.
'Why on earth... Rosa!'
The chain should have been concealing a respected former family head.
Jin had been fighting at a disadvantage intentionally, with the sole determination that he had to save such an ancestor.
Despite numerous opportunities to cut off his opponent's breath, he had passed up these chances, and even in moments where he could have inflicted fatal wounds, he steadfastly held back.
His inability to help his comrades who were fighting from behind, from the sides, from the front was because of this reason.
All his efforts were to rescue the ancestor, who should have been inside the chain, in the most intact state possible.
But what he had worked so hard to rescue turned out to be Rosa, the monster.
And in such a healthy condition...
Freed from her bonds, Rosa did not glow with a faint purplish hue like the others who emerged from the abyss, nor was she grotesquely transformed like a monster of chaos.
Rosa was simply human, no.
She was, you could say, the very embodiment of Runcandel.
Her long, black hair that seemed to be sucked in, eyes holding the glow of determination, a gaze that quietly yet heavily oppressed the beholder, two hands that seemed to never let go of the sword.
The lady of the family that led Runcandel for a long time in place of Shiron, the knight who was a giant of her era.
Rosa Runcandel was making eye contact with Jin.
Damn it!
Jin spat out a curse before he knew it.
His breath became momentarily fast, as if heartburn had struck.
With a cold dizziness and a rising urge to vomit, Jin reflexively created distance.
If the fight resumed like this, he felt like he would make a mistake.
He was had.
That was the first thought that came to mind. If the monster had staged this drama to give him a psychological shock, there couldn't have been a more successful outcome.
His allies were also shocked. For a moment, they too turned their gaze to Rosa, not their respective opponents.
'I must remain calm. This is just a scheme of the monster, that Rosa who looks like a human... is probably some sort of fragment created by the monster's power.'
Jin, gripping his sword tightly.
"Your bad habits have increased... monster. I didn't know you would go to such lengths to confuse me."
But to Jin's words, Rosa gave an unexpected response.
"Weren't you trying to save me because you know me?"
"…What?"
"Why do you call me a monster?"
Once again, Jin couldn't help but feel a gut-wrenching sensation.
Rosa, released from the chains, did not even possess the resonance unique to the resurrected in her voice.
She seemed like a truly living person.
She seemed like a person who would go to great lengths to protect Runcandel.
His heart was racing wildly.
"I am Rosa Runcandel. Why do you mistake the monster that has been binding me all this time for me?"
"What nonsense are you babbling..."
"Jin!"
"12th Generation!"
Behind him, he could hear the urgent voices of Hedo and Octavia.
Shiiit-!
At the same time, he felt a sharp energy stabbing into his back.
It was the sword energy that the enemy aimed at Jin.
Due to concentrating all his attention on Rosa, Jin reacted a bit slower than usual.
The sword energy grazed his back and a droplet of blood splashed out.
The wound wasn't deep.
The one who had shot the sword energy was the one-armed former family head.
'... No, is it really the former family head?'
What if another Rosa comes out when the chain is cut?
An indescribable sense of discomfort continued to bewilder Jin's brain.
As he dodged the sword energy flying at him again and looked back, he saw his exhausted comrades.
Bianca had almost mortally wounded the 29th generation, and although both Alpen and Lion were badly beaten, the match was not over.
Hedo was helping Octavia after finishing off the 35th generation.
Even while dealing with both of them, the one-armed family head was displaying a force stronger than when the battle first started.
Since Jin had just released another chain, the effect of the monster's influence on that family head had increased accordingly.
"Cough!"
Octavia vomited a mouthful of blood and buckled forward.
Hedo took several strokes of the family head's sword energy head-on to protect her. His massive body was filled with wounds.
"12th Generation? Are you the 12th generation of the family? Now that I look at it, your sword is Bradamante. Your name is Jin... Jin Runcandel. This is strange."
Rosa spoke as if she didn't know anything.
"Shut up!"
Jin threw himself towards Hedo. It seemed like he needed to buy him some recovery time, even if only temporary.
Rosa did not interfere with Jin as he started to run back.
Rather, she intercepted the sword energy of the former family head flying towards Jin, protecting him.
Rosa's sword, intercepting the sword energy, was not as powerful as the current monster or as Rosa was during her time as acting head of the family, as Jin remembered.
Jin decided not to think about the monster's intentions any further.
Jjeong-!
Jin's sword clashed with that of the former family head.
With just one exchange, Jin understood why Hedo and Octavia had struggled so much.
The family head's sword had the power to infuse the spirit into the opponent, like the monster's.
Now, the former family head was closer to being fused with the monster, not just being manipulated by it.
Jin invoked eternalization on Bradamante again.
He had to finish the former family head as soon as possible and sort out this chaotic situation.
'I cannot rule out the possibility that the former family head is another Rosa, but I have to verify it.'
He couldn't just shut out the possibility that he might be the real former family head, like Alpen.

If he shut out that possibility because of the overwhelming situation, because he suspected it, he would be giving up on the ancestors who had fought for the family, alive, dead, and even after an unwanted resurrection.
Therefore, he had to break the chains without killing.
While Jin was pondering, Rosa continued to stand guard, watching Jin's back.
Like someone who had something to say. But as if she didn't know where to start.
Without checking on Rosa, Jin extended his sword towards the former family head.
'I don't care if it's a trap, monster. I will not give up on even one of the ancestors who resisted you to the end.'
Even if it's not an ancestor and another Rosa appears, as before, he just needs to cut down all of them, including the Rosa behind him.
Jin's sword, charging at the family head, no longer harbored confusion. His inner turmoil caused by Rosa's sudden appearance was being sorted out.
As Jin, having regained his calm, began to handle the former family head, Hedo and Octavia quickly gained some leeway.
Bianca finally annihilated the 29th generation when Jin and the former family head finished about a hundred exchanges.
Hedo and Octavia also rejoined the fight, and the fierce bloody battle between Alpen and Lion had ended.
The bodies of Lion, Tucker, and Neph were being disintegrated into particles as they rolled on the ground due to the shockwave of the battle.
The battle, which had started evenly, now had a many-to-one structure.
No matter how much it has assimilated, the former family head is not a monster after all.
Up to now, he had wielded a flawless sword even with one arm lost, but it was his limit.
The reason he could hold on against five until now was because Jin decided not to kill the former family head.
If he had decided to kill, the battle would have been much shorter.
'Monster, stop this nonsense and come forward yourself.'
Kigik, hwarruk...!
Bradamante cut one of the chains covering the former family head's face. The eternalization stuck to the cracks and continued to melt the links of the chain.
The face inside the chain was slowly being revealed, and Jin's judgment was not wrong this time, either.
'It's not Rosa...!'
Although the chain hadn't completely broken yet, at a glance, it was a face completely different from Rosa's.
Just as Jin was about to cut the chain once more, the former family head suddenly lunged at him with Bradamante. As if he intended to get himself stabbed.
Jin immediately reacted and sidestepped.

It would only take a few more seconds for eternalization to burn away the rest of the chain, and he had no intention of losing an ancestor here. In a few seconds, the bond that tied the former family head would naturally melt away.
The former family head didn't chase after Jin, who had dodged to the side.
'Is he just going to let me go?'
The monster controlling the former family head's aim was not to have him stabbed and killed by Jin's sword.
The monster precisely predicted that Jin would dodge.
From the beginning, what the monster was aiming for was not Jin, but the one continuously watching Jin from behind.
It was Rosa.
All the allies were in front of Jin. The only one left behind Jin was Rosa.
Thuk-!
'Ah?'
The former family head's sword pierced Rosa's chest.
The monster had used swordsmanship almost flawless just by controlling the former family head, but for some reason, Rosa, standing behind Jin, couldn't even fend off that one blow.
It was certainly her own sword.
Rosa swallowed a groan and clutched the sword that had pierced her body.
As the former family head, who had stabbed her, fell and stopped moving, Rosa knelt on one knee and heaved.
Jin couldn't understand what was happening.
Why did the monster stab itself, and why was Rosa suffering as if she were human.
And why was such an ominous feeling overwhelming him.
He didn't understand anything.
But unconsciously, Jin ran towards Rosa.
It was a fatal wound. If the stabbed Rosa was indeed a human, she would soon die.
"Monster... what on earth are you doing."
"Do you still see me... as a monster."
"Why are you acting like a human...!”
Jin stopped talking, taken aback.
Because for some reason, Rosa looked much younger than he remembered.
Suddenly, Jin realized that Rosa had already looked young from the moment she broke the chain.
Facing her again, who looked like she was in her early to mid-twenties, just like his age.
His heart sank. Jin's breathing was getting rough.
"You seem to have a faint understanding of the situation now... Jin. You must be the child of me and Siron. After all, we agreed to give our last child that name...."
